sights.address: Vĩnh Khánh Street (Bến Vân Đồn to Tôn Đản), Ward 8 & Ward 9, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: District 4's famous after-dark ốc (snail) and seafood strip — nearly a kilometre of charcoal grills and plastic-stool eateries that fire up around dusk and run past midnight. Officially designated a Saigon food street in 2018 and named by VnExpress among the world's coolest snail streets; the single most concentrated street-seafood experience in the city (Ốc Oanh, a MICHELIN Selected snail house, anchors it).
